1111.summary: The class covers the opening of the book of Titus, focusing on the character of Titus and the responsibilities he had in managing ecclesias in Crete. It emphasizes the importance of godliness, sound doctrine, and proper ecclesial order, including dealing with heresy and maintaining unity.

1112.summary: The class covers Titus 2, focusing on the responsibilities of older members to younger ones, emphasizing the importance of teaching and modeling Christian behavior. It also touches on Ezekiel's vision of divine judgment and the future reign of Christ with the saints, highlighting the glory and holiness of God.
